questions.question: How many total births were recorded across all New York State hospitals combined in 2023?
questions.program:
import pandas as pd

df = pd.read_csv('nydoh_hospital_maternity_information.csv')
res = df[
    (df['Year'] == 2023)
    & (df['Hospital Name'] == 'Statewide - All Hospitals')
    & (df['Measure Name'] == 'Total Births')
]['Count'].iloc[0]
result = int(res)

questions.question: For cesarean deliveries across New York State in 2023, which anesthesia type was administered more often: Spinal Anesthesia or Epidural/Local Anesthesia?
questions.program:
import pandas as pd

df = pd.read_csv('nydoh_hospital_maternity_information.csv')
sub = df[
    (df['Year'] == 2023)
    & (df['Hospital Name'] == 'Statewide - All Hospitals')
    & (df['Measure Name'].isin(['Spinal Anesthesia', 'Epidural/Local Anesthesia']))
    & (df['Denominator'] == 'Cesarean Deliveries')
]
result = sub.loc[sub['Count'].idxmax(), 'Measure Name']

questions.question: In 2023, did over half of the infants fed any breast milk statewide also receive formula supplementation?
questions.program:
import pandas as pd

df = pd.read_csv('nydoh_hospital_maternity_information.csv')
pct = df[
    (df['Year'] == 2023)
    & (df['Hospital Name'] == 'Statewide - All Hospitals')
    & (df['Measure Name'] == 'Breast Fed Infants Supplemented w/Formula')
]['Percent'].iloc[0]
result = 'yes' if pct > 50 else 'no'

questions.question: In 2023, what was the combined statewide total of primary and repeat cesarean deliveries?
questions.program:
import pandas as pd

df = pd.read_csv('nydoh_hospital_maternity_information.csv')
res = df[
    (df['Year'] == 2023)
    & (df['Hospital Name'] == 'Statewide - All Hospitals')
    & (df['Measure Name'].isin(['Primary Cesarean', 'Repeat Cesarean']))
]['Count'].sum()
result = int(res)
